sloka: सो ऽभिवाद्य ततो रामं प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतेन्द्रियः ।उवाच वाक्यं धर्मज्ञं धर्ममेवानुचिन्तयन् ।। ७.१०८.१३ ॥
transliteration: so 'bhivādya tato rāmaṁ prāñjaliḥ prayatendriyaḥ ।uvāca vākyaṁ dharmajñaṁ dharmamevānucintayan ।। 7.108.13 ॥

translations.english: Then, having saluted Rama, the knower of Dharma, he spoke with folded hands and controlled senses, contemplating only righteousness.
